name: 视频阴影一致性
description: 分析视频帧中阴影的方向、强度和时间一致性。
useCase: Detecting manipulated videos through shadow behavior anomalies
mechanism: Tracks shadow positions, directions, and intensities across frames relative to light sources. In manipulated videos, shadows may not follow consistent physics - changing direction unnaturally, disappearing or appearing without cause, or exhibiting temporal flickering.
accuracy: Medium-High - 72-85% on composited and manipulated videos
source: Kee, E. & Farid, H. (2010) - Exposing Digital Forgeries from 3-D Lighting Environments, ICIP
algorithm: Shadow Detection + Light Source Estimation + Temporal Consistency Verification
parameters: Shadow threshold: adaptive, Light estimation: spherical harmonics, Consistency window: 20 frames
